hint: Use for a person who does something.

questions.first: Usain Bolt has won lots of gold medals.
questions.answer: Usain Bolt, who has won lots of gold medals, is from Jamaica.
alternatives: Usain Bolt, who is from Jamaica, has won lots of gold medals.

questions.second: She wants to become an interpreter.
questions.answer: Sue, who speaks four languages, wants to become an interpreter.
alternatives: Sue, who wants to become an interpreter, speaks four languages.

questions.second: He taught us how to swim.
questions.answer: We thanked the coach who taught us how to swim.
alternatives: We thanked the coach that taught us how to swim.

hint: Use for a thing or animal when adding information about it.

questions.second: Her poodle always jumps up at people.
questions.answer: Joey's dog is a poodle which always jumps up at people.
alternatives: Joey's dog is a poodle that always jumps up at people.

questions.answer: The story which I read last night was exciting.
alternatives: The story that I read last night was exciting.

questions.second: It leapt out of the water.
questions.answer: We saw a dolphin which leapt out of the water.
alternatives: We saw a dolphin that leapt out of the water.

hint: Use for a place where something happens.

questions.second: We fed the baby goats there.
questions.answer: We visited a farm where we fed the baby goats.
That is the library where I borrow books.
We stayed in a village where my grandmother grew up.

hint: Use for a person or animal to show that something belongs to them.

questions.answer: I spoke to a girl whose painting won first prize.
The farmer has a horse whose tail is very long.
We helped the man whose car had broken down.

hint: Use for a thing or animal in an identifying clause. It can often replace which.

questions.second: Mia baked it for the party.
questions.answer: The cake that Mia baked for the party was delicious.
alternatives: The cake which Mia baked for the party was delicious.

questions.second: It is playing on the radio.
questions.answer: I like the song that is playing on the radio.
alternatives: I like the song which is playing on the radio.

questions.answer: The puppy that we adopted yesterday is very friendly.
alternatives: The puppy which we adopted yesterday is very friendly.
